Manyan karawa biyu masu kayatarwa ga Bournemouth da Sunderland! Sunderland za ta yi tattaki zuwa filin wasa na San Siro a Italiya, yayin da Bournemouth za ta karɓi baƙuncin ƙattun Italiya a filin Vitality Stadium. Za a kawo cikakkun bayanai nan gaba, ciki har da waɗanda Celtic da Crystal Palace za su kara da su a gasar. Da farko, za a gudanar da zaben jadawalin gasar Europa League. Kungiyar Celtic ta Scotland tana cikin Tukunya ta Biyu. Kungiyoyin Premier League guda uku, wato Crystal Palace, Bournemouth da Sunderland, suna cikin Tukunya ta Uku. Asalin hoton,Getty Images Ana gudanar da jadawalin raba kungiyoyi na gasar Europa League da kuma Conference League a birnin Monaco. Za a gudanar da jadawalin ne a wani taro guda, inda za a fara da jadawalin Europa League kafin na Conference League. Kamar yadda yake a gasar Champions League da Europa League, gasar Conference League za ta kunshi kungiyoyi 36. Sai dai akwai bambanci, domin a gasar Conference League kowace kungiya za ta buga wasanni shida ne kacal a matakin league phase, maimakon wasanni takwas da ake bugawa a Champions League da Europa League. Asalin hoton,Getty Images Kocin Fulham Alvaro Arbeloa ya ce har yanzu kungiyar ba ta tabbatar da tsananin raunin da Luc de Fougerolles ya samu ba, wanda ya tilasta masa fita daga fili a rabin na biyu na wasan da suka buga ranar Alhamis. Ya ce suna fatan raunin ba mai tsanani ba ne. Ya kuma yi magana kan makomar dan wasan na kasar Canada a kungiyar: "Yana bukatar ya rika buga wasa a kowane mako. Wata kila za mu dauki matsaya cikin kwanaki masu zuwa kan abin da zai kasance mafi alheri a gare shi." Kocin Fulham, Alvaro Arbeloa, lokacin da aka tambaye shi game da yiwuwar sayen sabbin 'yan wasa kafin rufe kasuwar musayar 'yan wasa a mako mai zuwa, ya ce: "Ina ganin za mu iya inganta kowace matsayi a cikin tawagar. Idan ka tambayi kowane koci, kowa yana tunanin zai iya inganta tawagarsa. "Ni da na fara aiki kwanan nan, ina neman 'yan wasan da za su dace da tsarin wasan da nake son amfani da shi. Ina ganin muna shirye mu kara karfin tawagar a cikin 'yan kwanaki masu zuwa." Asalin hoton,Getty Images Abu na gaba ga Fulham shi ne tafiya mai nisa zuwa arewacin ƙasar domin karawa da Sunderland. Sunderland ta yi fice sosai a komawarta gasar Premier League a kakar da ta gabata, inda har ta samu tikitin buga gasar Turai duk da cewa da yawa sun yi hasashen za ta koma Championship kai tsaye. Tawagar Régis Le Bris ba ta bai wa Fulham wata matsala ba a kakar da ta gabata, inda Fulham ta yi nasara da ci 1-0 a gida a watan Nuwamba, sannan ta samu gagarumar nasara da ci 3-1 a filin Stadium of Light a watan Fabrairu. A gaskiya ma, karo na ƙarshe da Sunderland ta doke Fulham a gasar Premier League ya kasance shekaru 17 da suka wuce, kuma wasanni shida kenan ba tare da nasara a kan Fulham ba, tun watan Janairun 2009. Shin Arbeloa zai iya jagorantar Fulham zuwa wata nasara a wannan karon? Asalin hoton,Getty Images Brentford ta kammala daukar mai tsaron bayan West Ham, El Hadji Malick Diouf, a yarjejeniya da darajarta za ta iya kaiwa fam miliyan 40. Dan wasan bayan hagu dan kasar Senegal mai shekaru 21 ya sanya hannu kan kwantiragin shekara biyar, tare da zabin kara masa shekara guda. A karkashin yarjejeniyar, Brentford za ta biya fam miliyan 35 a farko, sannan karin fam miliyan 5 ta hanyar wasu sharuddan kari. Diouf ya buga wasan farko na West Ham a Championship da Burnley, amma ba a saka shi cikin tawagar wasanni biyu na gaba ba yayin da ake ci gaba da tattaunawar cinikinsa. Shi ne babban dan wasan baya da Brentford ta fi mayar da hankali wajen nema a wannan kasuwar musayar 'yan wasa. Tattaunawar ta tsaya cak a farkon bazarar nan kafin a sake farfado da ita a farkon wannan makon. Diouf ya dawo Premier League bayan West Ham ta fadi daga gasar a kakar da ta gabata. Haka kuma, sayar da shi ya kawo wa West Ham riba mai yawa, domin sun saye shi daga Slavia Prague kan fam miliyan 19 ne shekara guda da ta wuce. Diouf ya buga wasanni 34 a West Ham a kakar da ta gabata, inda ya taimaka aka zura kwallaye biyar. Kocin Brentford, Keith Andrews, ya ce "Shi dan wasa ne da ya dace da tsarin shekarun da muke nema, kuma har yanzu yana da babban damar ci gaba da inganta kansa." Diouf kuma ya ce Andrews ya gamsar da shi cewa zai iya ci gaba da bunƙasa da inganta wasansa a Brentford. Asalin hoton,Getty Images Kocin Everton, David Moyes, kan yadda ‘yan wasa ke taka rawar a wasu wuraren da ba inda suke bugawa ba na asali. “Ina ganin idan kana da ƙaramin tawaga kamar tamu, kana buƙatar ‘yan wasan da za su kasance masu sassauci, su iya taka leda a wurare daban-daban kuma su amince da ayyuka daban-daban a lokuta mabambanta. “Misali mai kyau shi ne yadda James Garner ya taka leda lokacin da aka mayar da shi matsayin mai tsaron baya na dama. “Muna son ‘yan wasan da ba za su rika tambayar dalili ba, waɗanda za su kasance a shirye su yi aikin da aka ba su. Mun yi hakan sau biyu ko fiye a wasu lokuta. Harrison Armstrong ma ya taka leda a wrare daban-daban a wasu wasanni a kakar bara. “Da yake muna da ƙaramar tawaga, dole ne mu sa ‘yan wasanmu su kasance masu iya taka rawar daban-daban, kuma abin farin ciki shi ne muna da kaɗan daga cikinsu da ke yin hakan.”

title: Mata 6 da suka taka rawa wajen ciyar da arewacin Najeriya gaba
text: Asalin hoton,social media/multiple A duk lokacin da ake tattauna tarihin yankin arewacin Najeriya, ba kasafai ake tattauna irin rawar matan yankin suka taka ba, musamman wajen samar da ci gaba da sadaukarwa. A tarihin yankin mai tsawo, mata sun taka muhimmiyar rawa wajen bunƙasa ilimi da siyasa da kiwon lafiya da tattalin arziki da adabi da aikin gwamnati da ci gaban al'umma. Daga zamanin tsoffin masarautun Hausad zuwa lokacin mulkin mallaka da kuma Najeriya bayan samun ƴancin kai, mata sun kasance cikin waɗanda suka taimaka wajen sauya rayuwar al'umma. Wasu sun yi amfani da ilimi, wasu suka yi amfani da siyasa, wasu suka yi amfani da aikin jarida, yayin da wasu suka shiga fannonin likitanci da gwamnati. Abin da ya sa waɗannan mata suka zama abin tunawa shi ne cewa ba sun cimma nasara a rayuwarsu ba ce kawai; sun kuma buɗe ƙofofi ga wasu mata da ƴan mata da suka zo bayansu. BBC ta kalato wasu matan guda biyar, waɗanda suma sun taka rawar gani wajen ciyar da yankin gaba. Sai dai ba su kaɗai ba ne matan da suka ciyar da yankin gaba, domin akwai fitattun matan da suka yi shuhura a arewacin Najeriya a baya, irin su Nana Asma'u Usman Ɗanfodio da Dadasare da su Ladi Kwali da sauran su. Asalin hoton,Social Media An haifi Gambo Sawaba ranar 15 Fabrairun 1933 a jihar Neja sai dai ta yi rayuwarta a garin Zariya da ke jihar Kaduna, a cewar Dokta Shu'aibu Aliyu. End of Wanda aka fi karantawa Ta fara karatu a makarantar furamare ta NA, kodayake karatun nata ya samu tsaiko bayan rasuwar mahaifinta. ''Duk da cewa ta yi aure tun tana ƙarama, (shekara13), bayan rasuwar iyayenta, hakan bai sanyaya mata gwiwa a fannin gwagwarmaya ba''. Tsohon shugaban gidan tarihin ya ce an tsare Hajiya Gambo Sawaba a kurkuku aƙalla sau 16 saboda gwagwarmayarta na neman yanci. ''Ta kasance ƙusa a siyasar arewacin Najeriya, inda ta kai matsayin mataimakiyar shugaban jam'iyyar GNPP, kafin daga baya ta koma jam'iyyar NEPU inda ta zama shugabar mata na jam'iyyar''. Gambo Sawaba ta riƙa sukar manufofin turawan mulkin mallaka a tarukan yaƙin neman zaɓen NEPU. Ta kasance ɗaya daga cikin matan da aka riƙa jin muryoyinsu a fagen fafutikar neman yancin kan Najeriya, in ji masanin tarihin. A ƙarshe ta rasu cikin watan Oktoban 2001. Asalin hoton,FACEBOOK / MARYAM LEMU Yanzu za ku iya samun labaran BBC Hausa kai-tsaye a wayoyinku. Latsa nan domin shiga Karshen Whatsapp An haifimarigayiya Bridget Aishaa garin Poole na yankin Dorset na ƙasar Ingila a 1940. Tana da shekara 13 da haihuwa sai ta fara tunanin sauya addininta, inda ta fara da duba addinan Hindu da na Bhudda amma basu gamsar da ita ba. Ta yi karatun jami'a a makarantar koyon al'adu da harsunan kasar Sin da na Afirka a jam'iar Landan (SOAS), inda ta karanta tarihi da al'adu da kuma harshen kasar Sin. A jami'ar ne kuma ta fara haduwa da dalibai Musulmai wadanda suka rika ba ta litattafan addinin Musulunci, kuma ba da daewa ba sai ta musulunta a shekarar 1961, a lokacin tana shekararta ta farko a jami'a. A lokacin ne ta bayar da gudunmawarta wajen kafa kungiyar dalibai Musulmai na makarantar ta SOAS a jami'ar Landan, kuma ita ce sakatariyar kungiyar ta farko. Bayan ta kammala karatun digiri na farko a jami'ar Landan, sai Aisha Lemu ta koma domin karatun babban digiri a kan harshen Ingilishi, kuma a lokacin ne ta fara ganin Sheikh Ahmed Lemu, wanda shi kuma ya isa Landan ne domin karo ilimi a jam'iar ta Landan. Bayan kammala digirinta na biyu sai ta koma Kano a 1966, inda ta fara koyarwa a makarantar nazarin Larabci, a lokacin shi Sheikh Ahmed Lemu ke shugabancin makarantar. An daura mata aure da Ahmed Lemu a watan Afrilun 1968, inda Aisha ta kasance matarsa ta biyu. Ta tafi Sokoto domin kama aiki a matsayin shugabar makarantar mata ta gwamnati. Daga baya ta koma jihar Neja bayan da aka kirkiri jihar daga cikin jihar Arewa maso yamma ta da a 1976, kuma ta zama shugabar makarantar horar da malamai mata ta Minna har 1978. Ita da maigidanta sun kafa Gidauniyar Ilimin Islama (IET), kuma ta kafa babbar kungiyar mata Musulmi ta Najeriya (FOMWAN) a 1985. Wannan layi ne Ta wallafa litattafai na addinin Musulunci Ta wallafa littafai da dama a fannin addinin Musulunci da ilimi wadanda aka rika amfani da su a makarantun sakandare na Najeriya. Cikin litattafan da ta wallafa akwai: The Role of Women and Marriage The Ideal Muslim Wife and Husband Animals in Islam Book: The Young Muslim Islamic studies for senior secondary schools Woman in Islam Farfesa Zaynab Alƙali, wadda aka haifa a shekarar 1950 a jihar Borno, tana daga cikin fitattun marubutan mata daga Arewacin Najeriya. Ta yi karatu a Bayero University Kano, inda ta samu digiri na farko da na biyu, sannan ta yi digiri na uku a jami'ar ABU da ke Zaria kamar yadda ta bayyana a wata tattaunawar da ta yi daBBC. Daga cikin fitattun littattafanta akwai: A cikin rubuce-rubucenta ta yi magana kan ilimin ƴan mata da aure da iyali da al'adu da matsayin mace da matsalolin da mata ke fuskanta. Nasararta Zaynab Alkali ta ba da gudummawa wajen: bunƙasa adabin Najeriya da wakiltar rayuwar mata daga Arewa  da inganta ilimi da ƙarfafa mata su shiga manyan sana'o'in ilimi da kawo batutuwan mata cikin adabi. A zamanin da ba kasafai ake jin muryoyin matan Arewa ba, Zaynab Alƙali ta zaburo ta kuma tsunduma cikin harkar rubutun adabi, daga nan kuma tauraruwarta ta fara haskawa. Littafinta na farko Stillborn ya yi fice a fagen adabi a Najeria, saboda yadda aka kikrkire shi, aka saukaka shi, aka kuma fito da irin gwagwarmayar da matan arewacin kasar ke yi. Asalin hoton,https://www.acephap.buk.edu.ng/hadiza-galadanci Farfesa Hadiza Galadanci, Farfesa ce a fannin mata da haihuwa (Obstetrics and Gynecology) a Jami'ar Bayero da ke Kano, Najeriya. Haka kuma ita ce daraktar cibiyar Africa Centre of Excellence for Population Health and Policy, cibiyar da Bankin Duniya ke tallafawa kamar yaddaThe Global Surgery Foundation. Farfesa Galadanci ta wallafa fiye da maƙaloli 100 na bincike game da fanninta, kuma ta kasance abin koyi mai ƙarfafawa ga mata, musamman mata masu aiki a fannin koyarwa da binciken likitanci a jami'o'i. Ana kuma bayyana ta a matsayin mace ta farko da ta samu horo a fannin likitan mata da haihuwa, sannan ta zama farfesa a wannan fanni a yankin Kano na Najeriya. Ta samu lambobin yabo da dama saboda jagorancinta da aikinta wajen inganta lafiyar mata masu juna biyu da haihuwa. Daga cikin lambobin yabon da ta samu akwai FIGO Women Award a shekarar 2018, da kuma Heroine of Health Award na shekarar 2023. A shekarar 2024, mujallar TIME ta zaɓe Farfesa Hadiza Galadanci cikin mutum 100 da suka fi tasiri a fannin kiwon lafiya a duniya. An haifi Laila Dogonyaro a ranar 10 ga Disamba, 1944, a Garun Gabas, wani gari da ke cikin gundumar Hadejia ta tsohuwar Jihar Kano (yanzu Jihar Jigawa), a Arewacin Najeriya. Mahaifinta ɗan ƙasar Siriya ne, yayin da mahaifiyarta Bahaushiya ce daga cikin Hausawa-Fulani. Laila ta halarci Makarantar Firamare ta Saint Louis da ke Kano, sannan ta samu gurbin karatu a Makarantar Sakandare ta Ilorin.  An aurar da ita tun tana da shekara 13 ga Alhaji Ahmed Gusau, wani dattijo da ke aiki da kamfanin G.B. Ollivant. An ce mijin Laila na farko ne ya fara gabatar da ita ga batutuwan fafutukar kare haƙƙin jama'a, yayin da mijinta na biyu, Ambasada MBG Dogonyaro, ya ba ta cikakken goyon baya. A shekarar 1963, ta zama ɗaya daga cikin waɗanda suka kafa Jam'iyyar Matan Arewa (JMA). Ƙungiyar ta kafa makarantu da cibiyoyin jarrabawar WAEC, sannan ta tallafa wa 'yancin mata na zaɓe a yankin. A shekarar 1977,Dogonyaro ta shiga harkokin siyasa kai tsayekamar yadda jaridar Daily Trust ta ruwaito, inda ta tsaya takarar zaɓe a mazabar Tudun Wada da ke Jihar Kaduna. A shekarar 1979, ta kasance mamba a jam'iyyar National Party of Nigeria (NPN), wadda ita ce jam'iyya mai mulki a lokacin. Duk da cewa ba ta samu nasarar lashe zaɓen ba, ta ci gaba da fafutukar ganin an ƙara shigar da mata cikin harkokin siyasa da shugabanci. Ba da daɗewa ba ta zama fitacciyar mai fafutuka kan batutuwan da suka shafi yara da mata. Laila Dogonyaro ta samu lambobin yabo da girmamawa da dama. Mafi shahara daga cikinsu shi ne lambar ƙasa ta Officer of the Order of the Niger (OON), wadda Gwamnatin Tarayya ta ba ta a shekarar 2001 saboda gudummawarta da kuma gwagwarmayarta. Laila Dogonyaro ta rasu a Aminu Kano Teaching Hospital (AKTH) da ke Kano a ranar Alhamis, 28 ga Afrilu, 2011, bayan gajeriyar rashin lafiya. An binne ta a garinsu na Garki da ke Jihar Jigawa. Hajiya Naja'atu Mohammed, wadda kuma aka fi sani da an haife ta a shekarar 1956, kuma ƴar siyasar Najeriya ce kuma mai fafutukar kare haƙƙin jama'a. A shekarar 2007, ta kasance ƴar takarar Action Congress of Nigeria (ACN) a mazaɓar Sanatan Kano ta Tsakiya. Haka kuma, an ce ita ce mace ta farko a cikin waɗanda suka shugabanci ƙungiyar ɗalibai ta SUG a Jami'ar Ahmadu Bello da ke Zariya (ABU). Ita ce kuma mace ta farko da ta zama mataimakiyar shugabar ƙungiyar ɗaliban Najeriya wato NANS. An haifi Hajiya Naja'atu a shekarar 1956 a tsakiyar birnin Kano, cikin gidan Alhaji Ali Abdullahi, wanda ɗan gurguzu ne kuma ɗaya daga cikin mutanen zamanin Malam Aminu Kano a Northern Elements Progressive Union (NEPU). Ta kawo sabon salo a siyasar mata a Najeriya a matsayinta na mai fafutukar siyasa. Ta kasance ɗaya daga cikin waɗanda aka zaɓa kuma mamban kwamitin da ke da alhakin ƙoƙarin samar da sulhu tsakanin ƙungiyar Boko Haram da Gwamnatin Najeriya.

title: Yadda minti 20 na shakatawa zai iya inganta lafiyarku
text: Asalin hoton,Getty Images Idan ka taɓa jin kwanciyar hankali bayan ka yi yawo a wurin shakatawa ko kuma ka yi yawo a cikin daji, ba tunaninka ba ne - ilmin halitta ne. Kasancewa a waje na iya haifar da sauye-sauye masu yawa a cikin jikinka ta hanyar rage kwayoyin hallitta na damuwa watau hormones , rage hawan jini da kuma inganta lafiyar hanji. Ba sai ka yi tafiya na tsawon sa'o'i kafin ka ji waɗannan fa'idodin ba, domin tasirin da ke tattare da hakan yana faruwa ne bayan mintuna 20 kacal, don haka ko da tafiya a lokacin cin abincin rana zuwa wurin shakatawa da kuma cin  sandwich a kan benci sau da yawa a mako zai iya amfanar jikinka da hankalinka. Ga hanyoyi guda huɗu da zama cikin yanayi na hutawa ta hanyar kai ziyara yanki mai bishiyoyi , wuri mai lambu ko kiwon dabbobi da sauransu zai iya taimakawa wajen inganta lafiyarka. Idan ka ga bishiyoyi kore, ka ji ƙamshin itacen  sannan ka ji ganyen da ke ƙara ko kuma sautin kukan tsuntsaye, tsarin jijiyoyinka - wata hanyar sadarwa ta jijiyoyi da ke sarrafa hanyoyin da ba su san komai ba - yana amsawa nan take. Wannan zai iya faruwa a lokacin ziyara zuwa wurin shakatawa na gida. "Muna ganin canje-canje a jiki kamar rage hawan jini, canjin yanayin bugun zuciyarka da kuma bugun zuciyarka a hankali - duk suna da alaƙa da kwantar da hankalin jiki," Baroness Kathy Willis, farfesa a fannin halittu a Jami'ar Oxford, ta shaida wa shirin BBC Radio 4 na What's Up Docs? cewa. Wani bincike da aka gudanar a Burtaniya, wanda ya shafi kusan mutane 20,000, ya gano cewa waɗanda suka shafe akalla mintuna 120 a kowane mako a gonar kore suna da yuwuwar samun ingantacciyar lafiya da kuma ingantacciyar lafiyar kwakwalwa. End of Wanda aka fi karantawa Shaidar fa'idodin yin amfani da lokaci a cikin na hutawa abin ƙarfafawa ne har wasu yankuna sun gwada abin da ake kira maganin zamantakewa na kore wanda ke haɗa mutane da yanayi don inganta lafiyar jiki da ta kwakwalwa, tare da tasiri mai kyau ga farin ciki da walwala. Yanzu za ku iya samun labaran BBC Hausa kai-tsaye a wayoyinku. Latsa nan domin shiga Karshen Whatsapp Tsarin hormones na jikinka shi ma yana shiga cikin aikin shakatawa. Willis ya ce yin lokaci a waje yana haifar da tsarin endocrine ɗinmu kuma yana rage matakan cortisol da adrenaline - hormones da ke ƙaruwa lokacin da kake cikin damuwa ko fargaba. "Wani bincike ya gano cewa mutanen da ke cikin ɗakin otal na tsawon kwana uku waɗanda ke shaƙar man gayen Hinoki (Jafananci cypress) sun ga raguwar sinadarin adrenaline da kuma ƙaruwa mai yawa a cikin ƙwayoyin halitta masu kisa a cikin jininsu." Kwayoyin halitta masu kashe ƙwayoyin cuta sune ƙwayoyin halitta da ke magance ƙwayoyin cuta a jiki. Mahalarta binciken har yanzu suna da ƙwayoyin halitta masu kashe ƙwayoyin cuta a jikinsu makonni biyu bayan shaƙar ƙamshin. Ainihin yanayi "yana kwantar da hankalin abin da ke buƙatar kwantar da hankali kuma yana ƙarfafa abin da ke buƙatar ƙarfafawa," kamar yadda Farfesa Ming Kuo daga Jami'ar Illinois da ke Urbana-Champaign, ya shaida wa BBC. "Kwanan karshen mako na kwanaki uku a yanayi yana da babban tasiri ga na'urorin yaƙi da ƙwayoyin cuta, har ma bayan wata guda zai iya kaiwa kashi 24% sama da na asali." Bincike ya kuma nuna ƙananan sakamako amma har yanzu suna ci gaba da faruwa sakamakon gajerun lokutan da aka yi a yanayi, in ji ta. Ƙamshin yanayi yana da ƙarfi kamar yadda ake gani da jin sa. Ƙanshin bishiyoyi da ƙasa yana cike da sinadarai masu rai da tsirrai ke fitarwa kuma "idan ka shaƙa su, wasu ƙwayoyin halitta suna shiga cikin jinin jiki." Willis ya ce itacen pine misali ne mai kyau na wannan domin ƙamshin dajin pine zai iya sa ka kwantar da hankalinka cikin daƙiƙa 90 kacal kuma hakan zai ɗauki kimanin mintuna 10. Za ka iya tunanin cewa tasirin shakatawa na yanayi yana cikin zuciyarka, amma wani bincike ya gano cewa har ma jarirai ƙanana waɗanda ba su da wani tunani da ke da alaƙa da takamaiman ƙamshi, har yanzu suna kwantar da hankali lokacin da wani ƙamshi da ke da alaƙa da kwantar da hankali, limonene ya shiga ɗakin da suke ciki. Asalin hoton,Getty Images Baya ga kwantar da hankalinka, yanayi na iya taimakawa wajen haɓaka ƙwayoyin cuta masu rai yayin da ƙasa da tsire-tsire ke cike da ƙwayoyin cuta masu kyau. "Su iri ɗaya ne da ƙwayoyin cuta masu kyau da muke samu a cikin probiotics ko abubuwan sha," in ji Willis. Farfesa Ming Kuo ya yi nazarin tasirin da ke kan abubuwa kamar saurin kamuwa da cututtuka da kuma lafiyar kwakwalwa, kuma ya ce numfashi a wasu na iya kara wa mutum kwarin gwiwa; kuma sinadarai masu kashe kwayoyin cuta da tsirrai ke fitarwa - wadanda ake kira phytoncides - na iya taimakawa wajen yaki da cututtuka. Dr Chris van Tulleken ya ce a matsayinsa na masanin kimiyyar kamuwa da cuta yana ganin yanayi a matsayin yanayi mai cike da kalubale wanda ke "kara wa garkuwar jikinka rauni". Yana sa 'ya'yansa su yi wasa da ƙasa a cikin daji wanda daga nan sai ya shiga cikin tsarinsu ta hanci ko baki. Asalin hoton,Getty Images Hakika, ba kowa ne zai iya shiga daji da son rai ba, amma labari mai daɗi shine, ba lallai ne ka yi ba. Ko zuwa wurin lambu da aka shuka  a gida ko furanni  na iya yin wani canji, a cewar Willis. A gano cewa, an nuna cewa furanni kamar fararen furanni ko rawaya suna haifar da mafi girman tasirin kwantar da hankali ga aikin kwakwalwa. Idan ana maganar kamshi, yi amfani da na'urar watsawa mai man shafawa kamar pinene wanda zai iya taimaka maka ka ji daɗi. Kuma idan komai ya gaza, ko da hoton daji zai iya taimakawa. Bincike ya nuna cewa kallon hotunan yanayi a kwamfutar tafi-da-gidanka ko kuma kallon wani abu mai launin kore na iya haifar da irin wannan sauye-sauyen da ke kwantar da hankalin kwakwalwa da kuma rage damuwa. "Kowane abu yana taimakawa," in ji Farfesa Ming Kuo. Mun yi amfani da ƙirƙirarriyar basira wajen fassara wannan labari daga harshen Ingilishi. Ma’aikacin BBC ya sake duba labarin kafin a wallafa.Karanta ƙarin bayani kan yadda muke amfani da fasahar AI.

title: Amurka da Isra'ila maƙiya Musulunci ne - Mojtaba Khamenei
text: Asalin hoton,AFP via Getty Images Ƴansandan Zambia sun gurfanar da magudun jam'iyyar adawa na babban zaben shugaban kasa da aka gudanar a wannan watan, wanda ake takaddama a kansa, bisa zargin cin amanar kasa. An tuhumi Brian Mundubile tare da abokin takararsa, Makebi Zulu, da wasu mutum goma sha shida. An kama mutum biyu ne a ranar Alhamis bayan da Shugaba Hakainde Hichilema ya matsa wa Majalisar Dinkin Duniya da ke Lusaka lamba kan ta mika su ga hukumomin kasar. Sun nemi mafaka ne a ofishin Majalisar Dinkin Duniya bayan da jami'an tsaro suka kashe wani tsohon minista tare da kama wasu 'yan siyasa a wani samame. Mista Mundubile ya yi watsi da zargin gwamnati cewa jam'iyyarsa na shirin tayar da bore domin kifar da gwamnati. Laifin cin amanar kasa a Zambia na iya haifar da hukuncin daurin rai da rai. Asalin hoton,Getty Images Gwamnatin Nijar ta ce ta sake karɓe iko da Sansanin Sojin 101 da ke birnin Yamai bayan harin da wasu sojoji suka kai kan sansanin da wasu muhimman wurare a babban birnin ƙasar. Hukumomi sun ce dakarun da ke biyayya ga gwamnati sun daƙile yunƙurin tare da dawo da zaman lafiya. Ƙungiyar Ƙasashen Sahel (AES) ta bayyana harin a matsayin yunƙurin tayar da zaune tsaye da wasu sojoji suka shirya, tana mai cewa an murƙushe shi saboda ƙwarewa da jajircewar dakarun gwamnati. Haka kuma talabijin na gwamnati ya wallafa hotunan kama wasu da ake zargin suna da hannu a boren. Rasha ta ce dakarunta na African Corps sun taimaka wa sojojin Nijar wajen dƙkile harin. Lamarin na zuwa ne a lokacin da gwamnatin Janar Abdourahamane Tiani ke fuskantar matsin lamba daga hare-haren masu iƙirarin jihadi, tare da nuna alamun rashin jituwa a cikin rundunar sojin ƙasar. Asalin hoton,AFP via Getty Images Masu kada ƙuri'a a Guinea-Bissau za su kada ƙuri'ar raba gardama a yau akan ko za a amince da wani sabon kundin tsarin mulki da zai ƙara wa shugaban ƙasar iko. Ƙuri'ar ta zo ne  ƙasa da wata goma bayan sojoji sun ƙwace mulki a ƙasar da ke yammacin Afirka. An shirya gudanar da zaɓen gama gari a watan Disamba mai zuwa domin mayar da mulkin farar hula bayan juyin mulkin da aka yi a kasar. Sai dai babbar jam'iyyar adawa ta ƙi shiga wannan ƙuri'ar raba gardaman. Asalin hoton,Getty Images An fara jin ta-bakin masu taimaka wa alƙali a shari'ar Lindsay Clancy, wata mata a jihar Massachusetts ta Amurka da ake tuhuma da kashe ƙananan ƴaƴanta uku a gidansu da ke wani yanki na wajen birnin Boston. A wata shari'a da ta ɗauki hankalin jama'ar Amurka, Clancy ba ta musanta cewa ita ce ta kashe yaran nata ba, amma lauyoyinta na cewa bai kamata a ɗora mata alhaki ba saboda tana fama da matsananciyar lalurar ƙwaƙwalwa. Karanta cikakken labarin a nan Asalin hoton,Getty Images Shugabar riƙon ƙwarya a Venezuela, Delcy Rodriguez, ta ce yarjejeniyar man fetur da ƙasarta ta ƙulla da Amurka, wadda aka sanar a ranar Asabar, za ta tabbatar da ci gaba da ikon Venezuela kan albarkatun ƙasarta. Ta ce yarjejeniyar, wadda ta bai wa Amurka iko akan fiye da ganga biliyan 65 na man fetur din Venezuela, har tsawon shekaru 25, kuma za ta bunkasa tattalin arzikin ƙasar. Rodriguez ta ƙara da cewa yarjejeniyar za ta mayar da dimbin albarkatun mai da iskar gas na Venezuela wata hanyar samar da kuɗaɗen da za a yi amfani da su wajen tallafa wa shirye-shiryen jin daɗi da walwalar jama'a. A nasa ɓangaren, shugaban Amurka Donald Trump ya sha alwashin amfani da arzikin man fetur mai yawa na Venezuela, bayan da Amurka ta kama shugaban ƙasar Nicolas Maduro, a watan Janairun da ya gabata. Asalin hoton,Getty Images Manyan jami'an Turkiyya, Saudiyya da Pakistan za su gana a Istanbul ranar Litinin domin taron farko na kwamitin haɗin gwiwa da aka kafa ƙarƙashin yarjejeniyar Makka da ƙasashen uku suka sanya wa hannu a watan Agusta. Ana sa ran ministocin harkokin wajen ƙasashen, ministocin tsaro da kuma hafsoshin rundunonin sojinsu za su halarci taron, wanda zai mayar da hankali kan aiwatar da yarjejeniyar tsaron haɗin gwiwa tsakanin ƙasashen uku. Yarjejeniyar ta tanadi cewa duk wani hari da aka kai wa ɗaya daga cikin ƙasashen zai kasance kamar an kai shi ga sauran ƙasashen biyu, tare da ƙarfafa haɗin gwiwar tsaro, daidaita ayyukan soji da kuma bunƙasa masana'antar tsaro ta hanyar haɗin gwiwa wajen samar da makamai da fasahohin kariya. Asalin hoton,CAN/Facebook Ƙungiyar Kiristoci ta Najeriya (CAN) reshen jihar Neja ta yi kira ga hukumomin tsaro da su ƙara ɗaukar matakan kariya a wuraren ibada, musamman lokacin sallar Juma’a da kuma bautar ranar Lahadi, bayan sace wasu masu ibada Musulmai da mazauna yankuna a ƙaramar hukumar Borgu. Shugaban CAN a jihar Neja kuma Bishop na Cocin Katolika na Kontagora, Bulus Yohanna, ya ce hare-haren da ake kai wa wuraren ibada barazana ce ga al’umma baki ɗaya, ba tare da la’akari da addinin waɗanda abin ya shafa ba. Ya kuma nuna alhini tare da jajanta wa al’ummomin Musulmin da abin ya rutsa da su. Kiran na CAN ya biyo bayan harin da ake zargin 'yan ta’adda ne suka kai wasu ƙauyuka a gundumar Dekara da ke Borgu, inda suka yi garkuwa da masu ibada daga masallatai yayin sallar Juma’a. Hukumomin tarayya da na jihar Neja sun ce suna aiki tare da jami’an tsaro domin ceto waɗanda aka sace da kuma dawo da zaman lafiya a yankin. Asalin hoton,Getty Images Ministocin kuɗi da gwamnonin manyan bankunan ƙasashen G20 za su gana a birnin Asheville da ke jihar North Carolina ta Amurka a ranakun 29 da 30 ga watan Satumba, inda ake sa ran batun takunkuman da Washington ke ƙaƙaba wa Iran zai kasance cikin muhimman batutuwan taron. Wani jami'in Ma'aikatar Kuɗi ta Amurka ya ce Washington za ta yi amfani da taron wajen jaddada muhimmancin bin takunkuman da ta sanya wa Iran. Haka kuma ana sa ran Sakataren Kuɗi na Amurka, Scott Besant, zai tattauna kai tsaye da takwarorinsa kan yadda ake aiwatar da shirin matsin tattalin arziki kan Tehran, tare da yin gargaɗin cewa kamfanoni da ƙasashen da ke ci gaba da hulɗa da Iran na iya fuskantar hukunci, ciki har da hana su amfani da tsarin dalar Amurka. Amurka ta ce tawagogi daga ma’aikatun kuɗi, harkokin wajen ƙasa da tsaro na ci gaba da tattaunawa da gwamnatoci a faɗin duniya domin ƙayyade lokacin kawo ƙarshen ayyukan da ke da alaƙa da Iran. G20 dai ya ƙunshi ƙasashe 19 tare da Tarayyar Turai da Tarayyar Afirka, kuma an kafa ƙungiyar ne domin ƙarfafa zaman lafiyar tattalin arziki da harkokin kuɗi a duniya. Asalin hoton,Getty Images Akalla mutum 37 ne suka mutu yayin da kusan 400 suka tsere daga gidajensu bayan wani harin jirage marasa matuƙa na Rasha ya afkawa wata ma’ajiyar makamai ta sojojin Ukraine a wajen birnin Kyiv. Harin, wanda ya faru a daren Juma’a, ya haddasa fashewar harsasai, nakiyoyi da jiragen yaƙi marasa matuƙa da aka adana a wurin. Fashewar ta lalata gidaje kusan 130 da ke kusa, ciki har da cibiyar kula da tsofaffi da masu nakasa. Haka kuma mutum 42 sun jikkata, ciki har da yara huɗu. Shugaban Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky ya ce bai kamata a ajiye makamai masu fashewa kusa da gidajen jama’a ba, yana mai bayyana lamarin a matsayin sakaci mai girma. Ya kuma sanar da fara bincike kan jami’an da suka amince da adana makaman a yankin da mutane ke zaune, yayin da ayyukan ceto ke ci gaba a yankin Bucha da abin ya shafa. Asalin hoton,Getty Images Shugaban Najeriya Bola Ahmed Tinubu zai bar Abuja domin fara hutun mako uku a Turai a matsayin wani ɓangare na hutunsa na shekara-shekara. Sanarwar da Fadar Shugaban Ƙasa ta fitar ta ce shugaban zai fara ziyartar birnin London na Birtaniya kafin ya ci gaba da hutun nasa. A cewar mai bai wa shugaban shawara na musamman kan yaɗa labarai da dabarun sadarwa, Bayo Onanuga, hutun zai kasance ne a matsayin hutun aiki, inda shugaban zai ci gaba da gudanar da wasu ayyukan gwamnati yayin da yake wajen ƙasar. Sanarwar ta ƙara da cewa ana sa ran Shugaba Tinubu zai dawo Najeriya bayan kammala hutun domin shiga zafafan shirye-shiryen yaƙin neman zaɓen shugaban ƙasa na watan Janairun 2027. Asalin hoton,Getty Images Jagoran addinin Iran, Mojtaba Khamenei ya ce Amurka da Isra'ila maƙiya ne ga al'ummar Musulmi baki ɗaya ba wai ga Iran da ƙungiyoyin gwagwarmayar Musulunci kaɗai ba, A cikin saƙon, Mojtaba Khamenei ya ce shugabannin Amurka da Isra'ila suna adawa da Iran amma ya jaddada cewa adawarsu ta shafi al'ummomin Musulmi na Gabas ta Tsakiya da Arewacin Afirka gaba ɗaya. Ya kuma ce hatta wasu shugabannin ƙasashen yankin da ake zargin suna hada kai da waɗannan ƙasashe ba su tsira daga wannan adawar ba. Ya kuma yi kira ga Musulmai su rungumi haɗin kai, yana mai cewa duk wanda ya aikata abin da zai haddasa rarrabuwar kawuna ko saɓani tsakanin Musulmai, ko da da gangan ko ba da gangan ba, yana taimakawa wajen cimma manufar maƙiya Musulunci. Tun daga shekarar 1981 ne ake gudanar da Makon Haɗin Kan Musulmi tsakanin ranar 12 zuwa 17 ga watan Rabi'ul Awwal, lokacin da ake gudanar da tarurrukan ƙasa da ƙasa kan haɗin kan Musulmi. Taron Ƙasa da Ƙasa na 40 kan Haɗin Kan Musulmi ya kammala a yau a Tehran. Asalin hoton,Getty Images Yawan mutanen da suka mutu sakamakon mummunar ambaliyar ruwa da ta afku a yankunan Nepal da Tibet ya ƙaru zuwa 752, a cewar hukumar rage haɗurran bala’o’i da gudanar da su ta Nepal (NDRRMA). Adadin ya ƙaru daga mutum 734 da aka sanar a baya, yayin da jami’ai ke ci gaba da tattara bayanai daga wuraren da bala’in ya shafa. Hukumar ta kuma ce adadin mutanen da suka ɓace ya kai 2,502. Ana ci gaba da aikin ceto da neman wadanda suka ɓace, amma jami’ai sun ce rugujewar hanyoyi, zaftarewar kasa da kuma tsananin wahalar isa yankunan da abin ya shafa na kawo cikas ga ayyukan agaji. Mahukunta sun bayyana cewa yanayin tsaunukan yankin da lalacewar muhimman hanyoyin sadarwa sun sanya kai kayan agaji da tallafi ga wadanda abin ya shafa ya zama “mai matukar wahala”. Hukumomi da ƙungiyoyin agaji na cikin gida da na kasa da kasa na ƙoƙarin kai ɗauki ga dubban mutanen da suka rasa matsugunansu sakamakon wannan mummunar ambaliya. Asalin hoton,Getty Images Hukumar Tsaron Farin Kaya ta Najeriya (DSS) ta umarci lauyanta, Akinlolu Kehinde (SAN), da ya nemi a ɗage shari’ar da ake yi wa ɗan takarar shugaban ƙasa na jam’iyyar AAC, Omoyele Sowore, kan zargin aikata laifukan intanet har bayan zaɓen shugaban ƙasa na 2027 kamar yadda Gidan talabijin na Channels ya ruwaito. A cewar wata majiya mai masaniya kan lamarin, an ɗauki matakin ne domin bai wa Sowore damar gudanar da yaƙin neman zaɓensa ba tare da shari’ar kotu ta hana shi gudanar da harkokinsa na siyasa ba. DSS ta shigar da ƙarar ne bayan wasu saƙonnin da Sowore ya wallafa a shafukansa na X da Facebook a watan Agustan 2025, inda ya kira Shugaba Bola Tinubu da suna “mai laifi”. Sai dai Sowore ya musanta zarge-zargen da ake masa, yana mai cewa shari’ar na da alaƙa da siyasa kuma an ƙaddamar da ita ne domin takaita masa ‘yancin faɗar albarkacin baki. Rahotanni sun ce shugaban DSS, Tosin Ajayi, ya yi wata ganawa da jami’an sashen shari’a na hukumar inda aka yanke shawarar neman ɗage shari’ar bayan da Hukumar Zaɓe ta Ƙasa (INEC) ta ba da damar fara yakin neman zaɓen 2027. Babban bankin Hadaddiyar Daular Larabawa (UAE) ya sanar da fara gudanar da bincike na musamman cikin gaggawa kan rassan Bankin Masar da ke ƙasar, bayan matakin Amurka na katse alaƙar bankin da tsarin kuɗin Amurka domin ƙara matsin lamba kan tattalin arziƙin Iran. A cikin wata sanarwa, babban bankin na UAE ya ce binciken zai haɗa da zurfafa nazari kan bayanan da suka shafi lokacin da hukumomin Amurka suka ambata a sanarwarsu. Bankin Masar, ɗaya daga cikin manyan bankunan gwamnati a ƙasar Masar, ya ce zai tuntuɓi Ma'aikatar Kuɗi ta Amurka domin neman ƙarin bayani tare da ɗaukar matakan da suka dace. Bankin ya kuma tabbatar da cewa rassansa da ke UAE na ci gaba da ba abokan hulɗa hidimomin banki bisa ƙa'idojin da suka dace. Matakin da Amurka ta ɗauka na daga cikin ƙoƙarin farko a fili na ware tattalin arziƙin Iran, inda Washington ta ce ta gano hanyoyin da gwamnatin Iran da dakarun juyin juya halin Iran ke amfani da su wajen samun kuɗaɗen shiga, tare da gargaɗin cewa ƙasashen da ke taimaka wa Iran za su iya fuskantar irin waɗannan takunkumai. Asalin hoton,Getty Images Yousef Pezeshkian, ɗan shugaban ƙasar Iran Masoud Pezeshkian, ya ce rayuwar mutanen Iran ba ta dogara ne kan aikin sarrafa da inganta sinadarin uranium ba, yana mai cewa "idan ba mu yi hakan ba, ba za mu mutu ba." A cikin wani saƙo da ya wallafa a shafinsa na Instagram, Yousef ya bayyana cewa ba ya adawa da sarrafa uranium, kuma yana biyayya ga duk wata shawara da Majalisar Tsaron Ƙasa ta Iran da kuma jagorancin ƙasar suka yanke. Sai dai ya ce ya kamata a fahimci dukkan fa'ida da illa kafin ɗaukar kowace irin shawara. Ya ƙara da cewa makamashin nukiliyar Iran ba ya dogara kacokan da aikin inganta uranium, yana mai nuni da cewa har yanzu man fetur ɗin da tashar samar da wutar lantarki ta Bushehr ke amfani da shi ana shigo da shi ne daga Rasha, ba a cikin gida ake samar da shi ba. Yousef Pezeshkian ya kuma ce akwai wasu fasahohi da suka fi muhimmanci ga tsaro da gudanarwar ƙasar, amma ba a ba su kulawar da ta dace ba, yana mai cewa Iran ba ta nuna irin wannan ƙwazo wajen bunƙasa waɗannan fannoni. Asalin hoton,Tasnim news agency Mataimakin ministan harkokin wajen Iran, Kazem Gharibabadi, ya ce duk da cewa Tehran da Muscat sun cimma matsaya kan samar da wata hanyar wucin gadi ta zirga-zirgar jiragen ruwa a Mashigar Hormuz, Iran ba za ta buɗe mashigar ba har sai Amurka ta cika alkawurran da ta ɗauka. Gharibabadi ya jaddada cewa Mashigar Hormuz har yanzu a rufe take, yana mai cewa idan wani jirgin ruwa ya ratsa ta mashigar, sai da izinin Iran. A wani labarin da ke da alaƙa da matsin lambar da ake yi wa Tehran, babban bankin Hadaddiyar Daular Larabawa (UAE) ya sanar da binciken rassan Bankin Masar. Matakin ya biyo bayan matakin da Washington ta ɗauka na katse alaƙar bankin da tsarin kuɗi na Amurka, a wani yunkuri na ƙara matsin lamba kan Iran. Masu bibiyar shafin labaran kai tsaye na BBC Hausa,Barkanmu da wannan safiya ta Lahadi. Kamar kodayaushe, za mu kawo maku labarai game da abubuwan da ke faruwa a Najeriya da sauran sassan duniya. Aisha Babangida ce ke fatan kasancewa da ku a daidai wannan lokacin. Za ku iya leƙawa shafukanmu na sada zumunta nafacebookdaXda kumawhatsappdomin karanta wasu labaran da kallon bidiyo da ma tafka muhawara. Ku kasance tare da mu.

title: An murƙushe yunƙurin sojoji na yin bore a Nijar - Gwamnati
text: Asalin hoton,Getty Images Gwamnatin Jamhuriyar Nijar ta yi bayani kan harbe-harben da aka kwashe tsawon dare ana ji har zuwa wayeywar garin Asabar a Yamai, babban birnin kasar inda ta ce ta murƙushe yunƙurin bore da wasu sojoji suka yi. Lamarin ya tayar da hankulan mazauna birnin tare da jawo hankalin ƙasashen duniya. A cikin sanarwar da ya karanta ta gidan talabijin na gwamnati, ministan tsaron Nijar, Janar Salifou Modi, ya ce kimanin ƙarfe 12:20 na dare wani rukuni na sojoji sun kutsa cikin sansanin soji na 101 da ke kusa da filin jirgin saman Diori Hamani a Yamai, inda suka yi garkuwa da wasu daga cikin abokan aikinsu. Sai dai ya ce dakarun ƙasar sun yi gaggawar mayar da martani, inda suka dakile yunƙurin tare da dawo da doka da oda. "Bayan jajircewar dakarun ƙasar, yanzu komai ya koma daidai kuma an murƙushe boren da suka so tayarwa," in ji sanarwar gwamnatin. Kafin wannan bayani daga gwamnati, babu tabbas kan asalin inda ake harbe-harben, kuma ba a fitar da wata sanarwa a hukumance ba. Ministan bai kuma yi karin haske kan ko akwai wadanda suka rasa rai ko kuma wadanda suka ji rauni ba. Asalin hoton,ANP Kamfanin dillancin labarai na Reuters dai ya ambato wasu majiyoyin tsaro na cewa an kai hari a filin jirgin saman Yamai tare da yunƙurin kutsawa fadar shugaban ƙasa. Wasu mazauna Yamai da BBC ta tuntuba sun ce sun ji karar harbe-harbe a kusa da filin jirgin saman Diori Hamani, fadar shugaban ƙasa da kuma wasu sansanonin soji. Wani mazaunin birnin ya shaida wa BBC cewa: "Tun misalin ƙarfe ɗaya na dare muke jin karar harbe-harbe da kuma wasu abubuwan fashewa." Wani mutum na biyu kuma ya ce ya ji karar harbe-harben lokacin da ya tashi sallar asuba. "Har ma mun yi addu'a a masallaci domin neman wa ƙasar zaman lafiya. Samari sun fito ƙofar gida suna tattaunawa kan abin da ke faruwa. Yawancin mutane na cewa 'yan ta'adda ne," in ji shi. Mazauna birnin sun ce har zuwa wayewar gari ana ci gaba da jin harbe-harbe a wasu sassan Yamai. Hotunan bidiyo da aka wallafa a shafukan sada zumunta sun nuna motocin yaƙi masu sulke da aka tura domin ƙarfafa tsaro a yankunan da ke kusa da filin jirgin saman birnin. Wata majiyar tsaro ta kuma shaida wa Reuters cewa jami'an tsaron Nijar sun yi galaba kan waɗanda suka kai harin, yayin da ake ci gaba da gudanar da bincike kan lamarin. Ta ƙara da cewa wasu daga cikin waɗanda ake zargi sun tsere. Tun bayan juyin mulkin da sojoji suka yi a watan Yulin 2023, inda suka hambarar da gwamnatin da aka zaɓa ta Mohamed Bazoum, Nijar ke fuskantar ƙalubalen tsaro daga ƙungiyoyin mayaƙa masu alaƙa da Al-ƙa'ida da kuma IS. Ƙasar mai arzikin ma'adanan yureniyom da danyen man fetur ta sauya akalar manufofinta na ƙetare bayan juyin mulkin, inda ta ƙarfafa alaƙa da Rasha tare da nisantar ƙasashen yamma. Nijar da makwabtan ta Burkina Faso da Mali sun kuma fice daga ƙungiyar Ecowas tare da kafa Ƙawancen Ƙasashen Sahel (AES). A baya, shugaban ƙasar Nijar Janar Abdourahamane Tiani ya zargi Faransa da hannu wajen ƙalubalen tsaro da ƙasar ke fuskanta, zargin da Paris ta musanta. Asalin hoton,Reuters Gwamnatin Jamhuriyar Nijar (CNSP) ta wallafa wani gajeren sako a shafinta na sada zumunta da safe, inda ta ce ta tura jami'an tsaro domin shawo kan lamarin kuma ta bukaci mutane su kwantar da hankalinsu. Sanarwar ta ce: "Mu kwantar da hankalinmu kuma a guji yada bayanan da babu tabbaci a kai. "Dakarun kasarmu sun fita domin kare kare kasarmu. "Mu kasance masu hada kai, mu kuma kiyaye tare da nuna goyon baya," a cewar sanarwar. End of content A ranar 18 ga watan Yuni mahara sun kai wani mummunan hari kan babban filin jirgin kasar na Diori Hamani da birnin Yamai, sai dai dakarun kasar sun yi ikirarin dakile yunkurin. Harin ya kasance shi ne na biyu a ƙasa da watanni 6 a filin jirgin na Yamai. Domin a watan Janairun wannan shekara ma masu iƙirarin jihadi sun kai wani harin a filin jirgin saman na Yamai, wanda ƙungiyar IS ta ɗauki alhakin kaiwa. A ranar 28 ga watan Janairun 2026 ɗin an samu harbe-harbe da fashe-fashe a kusa da babban filin jirgin sama na Diori Hamani Lamarin ya fara ne da misalin ƙarfe 6:00 na safe agogon ƙasar, kamar yadda kamfanin dillancin labarai na Reuters ya ambato, yana mai cewa an shafe kusan sa'a guda ana jin ƙasar. An jin ƙarar harbe-harben daga ƙofar shiga filin jirgin, kamar yadda wasu shaidu biyu suka bayyana wa kamfanin dillancin labarai na AFP. Jamhuriyar Nijar na fama da ƙungiyoyi masu iƙrarin jihadi da ke addabar sassan ƙasar kamar Boko Haram da ƙungiyar Jama'at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin (JNIM), mai alaƙa da Al-Qaeda. End of content A baya-bayan nan ne hukumomi a jamhuriyar ta Nijar suka ƙaddamar da wani aikin rushe gidaje fiye da 26,000 da ke kusa da filin jirgin saman na Diori Hammani da ke birnin Niamey. Hukumomin dai sun ce sun ƙudiri niyyar rushe gidajen ne bisa dalilan tsaro, wani al'amari da ya janyo tankiya tsakaninsu da ƴan ƙasar musamman mutanen da abin ya shafa.

title: Nepal: Hotunan yadda ambaliyar ruwa ta yi ɓarna a ƙauyuka
text: Sabbin hotunan tauraron ɗan adam sun yi bayyanin girman ɓarnar da aka yi a kogin Trishuli da ke Nepal sakamakon ambaliyar ruwa da ta faru ranar Laraba biyo bayan zaftarewar ƙanƙara. Hotuna sun nuna yadda ruwa ya kwararo daga sassan tsauni da yadda ya mamaye ƙauyuka tare da yin awon gaba da gadoji da kuma yadda ruwan ya rushe tashoshin wutar lantarki. Jami'ai a Nepal sun ce dubban mutane sun yi ɓatan dabo. Sashen tantance labarai na BBC ya ce ambaliyar ruwan ta fi tsanani a iyakar Nepal da Tibet. Hotunan tauraron ɗan adam mallakar kamfanin leƙen asiri na Vantor da ke Amurka, na ɗauke da bidiyon yadda ruwa ya mamaye yankin gabaɗaya. Akwai kuma wasu hotunan na'urar CCTV masu tsoratarwa da suka nuna yadda ambaliyar ruwa mai ƙarfi ta mamaye gine-gine yayin da mutane ke ƙoƙarin tserewa. Ana iya hangen gine ginen da suka rushe maƙale cikin taɓo daga nisan kilomita 2.5, inda ta kai mita 100 ta sama daga yankin da ruwan ya fara mamayewa. Tazarar mil ƙalilan daga kudu zuwa ƙauye Timure, a halin yanzu ƙauyen ya shafe gabaɗaya babu shi. Katangar kwarin ruwan na da tsawon mita 50. Hotuna sun nuna yadda taɓo ya lulluɓe gidajen da ke gangare gabaɗaya. End of Wanda aka fi karantawa Kilomita 10 ta ƙasa daga inda kogin Trishuli ke gangarawa ta Syapru Besi, hotunan  tauraron ɗan Adam sun nuna yadda taɓo da duwatsu da kuma ɓaraguzai suka rufe ƙauyen. Gidaje da sauran gine-gine da gadoji da wata cibiyar samar lantarki sun ɓace. Ɗaya daga cikin manyan ƙauyuka da ambaliyar ruwan ta shafa shi ne Trishuli, inda wasu daga ciki hotunan bidiyo da aka samu tun da daga farko suka nuna yadda ibtila'in ya fara. Wani hoton tauraron ɗan Adam na garin da kuma na filayen noma da ke kewaye da yankin mai nisan kilomita 45 daga kan iyaka, ya nuna yadda ruwa ya yi awon gaba da wata unguwa gabaɗaya. Yanzu za ku iya samun labaran BBC Hausa kai-tsaye a wayoyinku. Latsa nan domin shiga Karshen Whatsapp Wani bidiyon da aka tantance ya nuna yadda gada ta ruguje ya yinda da kogin ke ambaliya. A daidai lokacin da wani bidiyo da aka ɗauka daga cikin wata motar ɗaukar fasinja daga ƙasa ya nuna yadda mutane cikin tsoro ke  ƙoƙarin tserewa lokacin da suka ga ruwa na kwarara daga kogin. Cikin wani bidiyon mai abin mamaki kuma an ga yadda mutane ke fakewa cikin wani gida sannan suka leƙo son kallon yadda ruwa ke shafe komai a ƙasa tare tura manyan ɓaraguzai da ababen hawa jikin wani gini. Cikin Ikon Ubangiji gidan ya tsira ya yinda ake hango wadanda suka fake a ciki, a wani bidiyon kuma an gansu a tsaye kewaye da taɓo bayan janyewar ruwan. Hotuna daga kamfanin tauraron ɗan Adam na Planet Labs wanda aka fitar ranar Asabar sun bayar da bayanin abinda ya haifar da ibtila'in lokacin da ƙanƙara ta zaftare, wani jirgi mara matuƙi ne ya ɗauki hoton bidiyon lamarin. Hotunan tauraron ɗan Adam sun nuna yadda wani ɓangaren ƙanƙarar ya zaftare ya faɗi ƙasa sannan ya samar da wata hanya cike da duwatsu da ɓaraguzai a hanyar ruwa. An zaro bishiyoyi masu tsayin mita 300 a inda zaftarewar ta sauka. Hanyar da ta lalace ta bi ta yamma inda ta ratsa cikin kogin da ya cika, kafin ta nufi kudu. Hotunan tauraron ɗan Adam sun kuma nuna samuwar wani tafki mai shinge a kan hanyar da zaftarewar ta samar, abinda hukumomin Chaina suka yi gargaɗin cewa zai haifar da wata ambaliyar ruwan dama kuma ya haifar da cikas a ƙokarin aikin ceto. Dr. Argha Banerjee masanin ilmin ƙanƙara a wata cibiyar bincike da ke Indiya, ya shaidawa BBC cewa zai yi wahala a iya tantance inganci da ƙarfin shingen ko kuma a tabbatar da cewar tafkin zai iya janyewa da kansa. Ya ƙara da cewa tsakanin Laraba da Alhamis yawan ruwan ya ragu a yankin, duk da cewar ruwa na ci gaba da kwarara zuwa cikin tafkin. Dr. Banerjee ya ce akwai magudanar ruwa da ake iya gani, wadda ke nuna cewar ruwan ya ragu. Har yanzu ba a kammala tantance irin ɓarnar da ambaliyar ruwan ta yi a iyakar Tibet  ba. Yankin da Chaina ta mamaye a shekara ta 1950, inda kafofin watsa labarai na ƙasashen waje ke fuskantar matuƙar wahala wajen samun labarai. Sashen tantance labarai na BBC bai samu wani bidiyo da ya tabbatar da sahihancin sa daga yankin ba. Kamfanin tauraron ɗan Adam na Vantor ne ya iya samar da hotunan abubuwan da suka faru ya yin mummunar ambaliyar ruwan - a matsayin wani abu da hukumomi zasu iya amfani da shi wajen gano waɗanda suka ɓace da kuma samun gawarwakin waɗanda suka mutu a ibtila'in. Ƙarin bayani daga Shruti Menon da Merlyn Thomas da Alex Murray. Zane-zane daga Mesut Ersoz da Mike Hill. Mun yi amfani da ƙirƙirarriyar basira wajen fassara wannan labari daga harshen Ingilishi. Ma’aikacin BBC ya sake duba labarin kafin a wallafa.Karanta ƙarin bayani kan yadda muke amfani da fasahar AI.

title: Da gaske kurkur na ɗauke da sinadaran da ke inganta lafiya?
text: Asalin hoton,Getty Images An daɗe ana danganta kurkur (turmeric) da fa'idodin lafiya, inda wasu ke ganin yana taimakawa wajen rage kumburi da kuma kare jiki daga wasu cututtuka. Amma mene ne hujjojin kimiyya ke cewa kan wannan ikirari? Kurkur wani kayan ƙanshi ne da ake amfani da shi sosai a abinci a sassa daban-daban na duniya. Ko dai a gashin kaji na curry na Indiya ko laksa na Malaysia, ko kuma macher jhol na Bangladesh, kurkur na daga cikin sinadaran da ake yawan amfani da su. "Mu ƴan Punjab ne, kuma ba zan iya tuna wani abinci da ba mu sanya kurkur a cikinsa ba," in ji Ragini Kashyap, mai bincike kan al'adun abinci da kuma mai gabatar da shirin podcast kan Kudancin Asiya, a wata hira da shirin Food Chain. Akwai kusan nau'o'in kurkur 30 da ake amfani da su a yankunan Asiya, Afirka da Kudancin Amurka. Amma tasirin wannan kayan ƙanshi ya bazu zuwa sassa daban-daban na duniya, yayin da al'adun mutanen Kudancin Asiya suka yaɗa amfani da shi zuwa tsibiran Bali da Fiji da kuma yankin Caribbean. An gano kurkur a cikin wasu tsofaffin rubuce-rubuce tun fiye da shekaru 2,500 da suka wuce, a cewar Ragini Kashyap. A yankin Kudancin Asiya, an daɗe ana kallon kurkur a matsayin wani sinadari mai taimakawa wajen yaƙi da ƙwayoyin cuta da kuma rage kumburi. "Idan na ji ba ni da lafiya, kurkur na daga cikin abubuwan farko da ke zuwa raina. Yana sa mutum ya ji daɗi kuma mutane da yawa suna ganin yana da wasu siffofin magani," in ji Kashyap, wadda ke zaune a Dubai. A Indiya kuma,  ana amfani da kurkur a wani ɓangare  na bikin Haldi, wata al'ada da ake yi kafin aure, wadda ta ƙunshi shafa man kurkur a fuska domin ƙawata ta. Asalin hoton,Getty Images A yanzu, tallace-tallacen kayayyakin kurkur na ƙaruwa yayin da masu amfani da kayayyaki a ƙasashen Yamma ke ƙara rungumar amfani da shi. End of Wanda aka fi karantawa Ana tallata ƙarin sinadarin kurkur, wanda galibi ke ɗauke da curcumin, a matsayin wani abu da zai iya taimakawa wajen inganta lafiyar jiki ta fannoni daban-daban, tun daga ƙarfafa ƙashi zuwa bunƙasa garkuwar jiki. Ms Kashyap ta ce shaharar kurkur na iya kasancewa sakamakon yadda mutane ke yaɗa labaran abubuwan alherin da suka gani ko suka samu daga amfani da shi a shafukan sada zumunta. "Idan ko da ƙaramin ɓangare na mutane biliyan ɗaya sun yi imani cewa kurkur na iya magance matsaloli iri-iri, hakan na nuna cewa saƙon ya bazu kuma ya samu karɓuwa a faɗin duniya," in ji ta. Amma ba kowa ne ya yarda da ikirarin fa'idodin kurkur ga lafiya ba. Dr Kathryn Nelson, wata masaniyar ilimin sinadarai a jihar Minnesota ta Amurka, ta gudanar da bita kan fiye da takardun bincike 100 da suka shafi sinadarin curcumin. "Mun gano cewa ana danganta masa ikon yin komai, amma a zahiri akwai yiwuwar ba ya yin komai," in ji ta. Dr Nelson ta ce matsalar kurkur na iya kasancewa a tsarin sinadaransa, wanda ke sa nazarin sa ya zama mai wahala. Ta bayyana cewa sinadarin na iya yin tasiri a gwaje-gwaje ta hanyoyin da za su sa ya bayyana kamar yana aiki, alhali ba haka ba ne. Ta kuma ce jiki ba ya shan curcumin sosai, domin idan an sha shi ta baki, ƙananan adadi ne kawai ke shiga cikin jini. Asalin hoton,Getty Images Yanzu za ku iya samun labaran BBC Hausa kai-tsaye a wayoyinku. Latsa nan domin shiga Karshen Whatsapp An yi bincike sosai kan kurkur tsawon shekaru da dama, amma sakamakon yakan ci karo da juna saboda ingancin binciken ya bambanta. Ba a gudanar da bincike da yawa da ke nuna fa'idarsa ga mutane ba, in ji Farfesa Amit Garg, ƙwararren likita a fannin cututtukan ƙoda a Cibiyar Kimiyyar Lafiya ta London da ke Landan, Ontario, a Canada. Shi da abokan aikinsa ne suka gudanar da bincike guda biyu mafi girma zuwa yanzu. Na farko shi ne a tabbatar ko curcumin zai iya hana rauni da kumburi ga mutanen da ke fama da matsalar jijiyar jini - amma a wani gwaji da ya shafi marasa lafiya 600 ba su tabbatar da wani amfani mai ƙarfi ba. Sai suka gwada ƙaramin curcumin ga mutanen da ke fama da cutar ƙoda don ganin ko yana inganta lafiyar ƙodarsu ko kuma yana hana ci gaban cutar ƙodarsu - amma ba su iya nuna cewa haka lamarin yake ba. Amma ta yaya za mu iya bayyana gaskiyar cewa akwai tarihin mutane suna amfani da shi a matsayin maganin magani tsawon dubban shekaru, musamman a Indiya? To, shin ƙwararru suna ganin cewa ƙarin kayan abinci masu tsada sun cancanci hakan? "Ina ganin ya kamata mu faɗaɗa bincike. Amma ya kamata mu samu mizani, idan muna cewa wani abu yana da wani tasiri, ya kamata ya dogara ne akan tabbaci," in ji shi. Amma bai ga wata matsala ba idan mutane sun yi amfani da shi wajen daɗaɗa abincinsu. "Idan mutane suna jin daɗin abincin da aka yi da kurkum, zan ƙarfafa su su ci gaba da yin hakan." Mun yi amfani da ƙirƙirarriyar basira wajen fassara wannan labari daga harshen Ingilishi.
